authority: Cambridge IGCSE Business Studies 0450 syllabus for 2026, section 3, matched against 84 published question papers and mark schemes, 2020-2025.
evidence_window: 1169 question parts carrying 6660 marks, mined from 84 published mark schemes across 18 examination series, 2020-2025.
method: Each question part matched to the objective sharing the most distinctive syllabus vocabulary (IDF-weighted, syllabus terms only, score floor 3.0). Unmatched parts are reported, not distributed.
principle: RS-05: past-paper frequency may calibrate emphasis but MUST NOT remove or weaken syllabus-mandated coverage.

objectives.syllabus_text: Different ways in which businesses can grow, e.g. internal/external
Advantages and disadvantages of different channels, e.g. use of wholesalers, retailers or direct to consumers
